rules.name: combined-var-stuck-01-history
rules.sql: SELECT localtimestamp AS db_now, current_setting('TimeZone') AS db_time_zone, max(start_time) AS last_start_time, count(*) AS rows_since FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND processing_type = 'Combined VAR' AND start_time >= :since

SELECT position AS procedure_name, status, count(*) AS runs, min(start_time) AS first_start, max(start_time) AS last_start FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND processing_type = 'Combined VAR' AND start_time >= :since GROUP BY position, status ORDER BY position, status

SELECT h.position AS procedure_name, h.username, h.start_time, h.status, round(extract(epoch FROM (localtimestamp - h.start_time)) / 3600, 1) AS age_hours, split_part(h.file_name, '/', 1) AS execution_id, h.original_file_name, n.status AS next_run_status, n.start_time AS next_run_start FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history h LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT x.status, x.start_time FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history x WHERE x.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND x.processing_type = 'Combined VAR' AND x.position = h.position AND x.start_time > h.start_time ORDER BY x.start_time LIMIT 1 ) n ON true WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant AND h.processing_type = 'Combined VAR' AND h.start_time >= :since AND h.status = 'Processing' AND h.start_time < localtimestamp - make_interval(hours => (:stuckHours)::int) ORDER BY h.start_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT position AS procedure_name, username, start_time, completion_time, status, file_size, split_part(file_name, '/', 1) AS execution_id FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND processing_type = 'Combined VAR' AND start_time >= :since ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 40

SELECT position AS procedure_name, count(*) AS runs, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (completion_time - start_time))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS median_minutes, round((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM (completion_time - start_time))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS p90_minutes, round((max(extract(epoch FROM (completion_time - start_time))) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS max_minutes FROM opera.oga_bulk_upload_history WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND processing_type = 'Combined VAR' AND start_time >= :since AND status = 'Success' AND completion_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY position ORDER BY position

expect.reason: no Combined VAR run is stuck in Processing longer than stuckHours
